notesBlock.why: a valid block (format blueline-notes, version 1) as the last element of <body>; every < in its JSON is \u003C, including the '</script>' and '<!--' in note n-0001's text, so neither can end the block (section 8, Escaping). baseSha is the sha256 of the file with the block's <script> element removed. The mapper removes it before mapping, so no run comes from it, and the served copy does not contain it
notesBlock.decoy: a second <script type="application/vnd.blueline+json" id="blueline-notes"> inside <template id="callout-tpl"> is page content: never read as notes (its note n-0099 by mallory-zz99 must never appear), served and mapped as it is, and cloned into slide 3 by the page

expect.why: parsed text before the notes block; offsets before the block are unaffected by its removal
